cases.scenario: Signed-out visitor cannot open a signed-in screen or call the API
cases.given: A fresh browser with no session; a meeting exists
cases.when: Open /mgmt/meetings directly; then call GET /api/meetings from the same browser
cases.then: The browser lands on the sign-in page; the API answers 401 and returns no meeting data
cases.note: Spot-check on any two other signed-in screens as well

cases.scenario: Repeated wrong passwords for one email are throttled
cases.given: An active account; no sign-in attempts in the last minute
cases.when: Submit a wrong password 6 times within 60 seconds for that email
cases.then: From the 6th attempt the form shows "Bạn đã thử quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng thử lại sau ít phút." (MSG414, HTTP 429 with Retry-After); after the window passes the correct password signs in

cases.requirement: Role-based access control and least privilege
cases.scenario: Member cannot read a meeting they are not invited to by guessing its URL
cases.given: A published meeting of which Member D is not a participant; its URL copied from the Organizer's browser
cases.when: Signed in as Member D, open the copied URL; then call GET /api/meetings/{id}
cases.then: The page shows the same not-found screen as an unknown URL; the API answers 404, not 403, and the meeting does not appear in Member D's list
cases.note: 404 hides that the row exists (AGENTS.md 403/404 rule)

cases.scenario: Secret document is not reachable through a guessed download link
cases.given: A Secret document attached to a meeting Member D is not on; its download link copied from an authorised browser
cases.when: Signed in as Member D, open the copied link
cases.then: No file bytes are returned (404); the attempt does not appear as a successful access in the audit log
